admission.justification: Unit tests verify self-contained unverified-locally status assembly and fsync-failure temp-file cleanup, preventing misleading verification claims or truncated audit artifacts on disk.

applicability: Assembly of VerificationStatus and disk persistence of provenance.json and verification-status.json in src/rh_pipeline/audit/status.py.
conditions: provenance.note_digests must contain either both verification/NOTES.md and verification/static-scan.txt with non-empty SHA-256 digests (legacy layout) or neither (condensed layout, producing None/None); a partial pair or empty digest raises AuditInputError.
Both JSON payloads are serialized before creating audit_dir, written and fsynced to temporary files inside audit_dir, replaced via os.replace, and unlinked on failure.
exclusions: ReplayPin metadata stays in provenance.json and is not copied into VerificationStatus; filesystem OSError failures propagate directly to the caller.
statement: build_verification_status assembles a self-contained VerificationStatus with build_status='unverified-locally' and paired-optional verification-note digests (both non-empty or both null), and write_audit_artifacts stages both temporary files in audit_dir before atomically replacing provenance.json and verification-status.json with cleanup on failure.
title: Self-contained VerificationStatus and atomic audit artifact replacement
